entryPointCandidates.name: posegraph.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Builds and optimizes an offline keyframe pose graph from tracked frames — odometry edges between consecutive keyframes plus loop-closure edges between spatially close, temporally distant keyframe pairs — then propagates the corrected keyframe poses onto every in-between frame via interpolation.

file:scanner/camera.py.name: camera.py
file:scanner/camera.py.summary: Manages the RealSense D455 video pipeline: starts depth+color streaming, builds the depth post-processing filter chain and depth-to-color alignment block, and locks auto-exposure/white-balance so TSDF colors stay consistent across a scan.

file:scanner/capture.py.name: capture.py
file:scanner/capture.py.summary: Defines CaptureSession, the realtime capture loop that orchestrates camera+IMU acquisition, IMU-primed frame-to-model tracking with relocalization, TSDF integration, background frame recording, and crash-safe finalization into the offline refinement pipeline.

file:scanner/frameio.py.name: frameio.py
file:scanner/frameio.py.summary: Handles frame and metadata I/O: a background-threaded FrameWriter that saves depth/color PNGs and JPEGs without blocking the tracking loop, plus loaders for recorded RGB-D frames and the JSON scan metadata used by the offline refinement pipeline.

file:scanner/mapping.py.name: mapping.py
file:scanner/mapping.py.summary: TSDF voxel block grid operations: extracting and exporting point clouds/meshes in 8-bit-RGB legacy format for external viewer compatibility, and the offline re-integration pass that re-fuses recorded frames at a finer voxel resolution.

file:scanner/pipeline.py.name: pipeline.py
file:scanner/pipeline.py.summary: Offline reconstruction pipeline shared by live capture and --refine-only: optimizes the tracked trajectory via pose-graph optimization, re-integrates recorded frames, saves the point cloud, and can rebuild a full scan from a previous session's frames directory without touching the camera.

file:scanner/tracking.py.name: tracking.py
file:scanner/tracking.py.summary: Shared RGB-D odometry helper wrapping Open3D's multi-scale hybrid odometry with tuned convergence criteria, used by realtime tracking, relocalization, and the pose graph for any tracking path that needs an initial transformation.

file:scanner/config.py.name: config.py
file:scanner/config.py.summary: Module-level tuning constants for tracking health, relocalization, loop closure, and IMU gyro integration, each documented with guidance on which to adjust first when adapting the scanner to a new environment.

file:scanner/imu.py.name: imu.py
file:scanner/imu.py.summary: Implements gyro-aided tracking support: accumulates high-rate IMU angular-velocity samples arriving between video frames into a rotation prior for RGBD odometry, and starts a dedicated librealsense pipeline for the motion module.

file:scanner/posegraph.py.name: posegraph.py
file:scanner/posegraph.py.summary: Builds and optimizes an offline keyframe pose graph from tracked frames — odometry edges between consecutive keyframes plus loop-closure edges between spatially close, temporally distant keyframe pairs — then propagates the corrected keyframe poses onto every in-between frame via interpolation.

file:scanner/transforms.py.name: transforms.py
file:scanner/transforms.py.summary: Small SO(3)/SE(3) math helpers (rotation-vector exponential map, geodesic rotation angle, rigid-transform interpolation) built on cv2.Rodrigues, avoiding a scipy dependency.

file:realtime_pointcloud.py.name: realtime_pointcloud.py
file:realtime_pointcloud.py.summary: Thin backwards-compatibility entry point at the project root that delegates straight to scanner.cli.main, kept so the scanner can still be launched as a standalone script.

file:scanner/__main__.py.name: __main__.py
file:scanner/__main__.py.summary: Package execution hook that lets the scanner be launched via `python -m scanner`, delegating to scanner.cli.main.

file:scanner/cli.py.name: cli.py
file:scanner/cli.py.summary: Command-line interface for the D455 scanner: defines all CLI arguments (voxel sizes, depth range, keyframe thresholds, IMU/mesh/view toggles) and the main() function that dispatches to either offline refinement or a full realtime capture session.
